stem.text: A white powder is a mixture of sodium chloride and sodium iodide. It is dissolved in water in a test-tube. An excess of aqueous silver nitrate is added to the test-tube. A precipitate, X, is observed.
An excess of concentrated ammonia is then added to the test-tube containing X. After the test-tube has been shaken, a precipitate, Y, is observed.
Which statement about X or Y is correct?

A.text: X is a pure white colour.
